command_ordering: Every ordinary accepted LLD-02 command follows LLD-01 ordering: idempotency check -> pure bounded preflight -> open UnitOfWork -> load/revalidate authoritative state -> detect semantic NO_CHANGE when applicable -> allocate immutable IDs -> insert command_receipt -> domain/lifecycle writes -> audit -> commit. Any later failure rolls the receipt back with the command.
preflight_rule: Pure normalization, field-bound checks and syntax validation occur before BEGIN IMMEDIATE where possible. State-dependent uniqueness/eligibility/review freshness is always revalidated inside the authoritative UnitOfWork. No external I/O, DNS, operator wait or unbounded computation occurs while the write transaction is held.
resolution_rule: An implementation or review tool resolves a command by exact name plus optional target specialization into exactly one command leaf. The aggregate index owns common ordering/preflight semantics only and does not duplicate leaf command bodies.
